name: styles-page
goal: Readers can inspect every supported Harness app style token, including colors, typography sizes, font styles, and font families.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: specification/features/planned/styles-page.md defines branch/commit navigation, CSSOM-backed token inventory, typography/color display, responsive layout, and red-green browser proof.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Added the branch and commit aware Styles route, navbar entry and CSSOM driven catalog for 35 color, font, type, text style and layout tokens. Responsive screen and registered page/style units are in the rebased Styles commits.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: The pre-implementation Styles route test failed at a86c67010. After implementation and latest-main rebase, focused Playwright passed 7/7 and report unit tests passed 29/29. The strict green recorder refused the checkpoint because the frozen full test corpus changed between red and green; root bun run check remains deferred per Daniel. Hosted lint exposed route parser/builder complexity at c8dc9136a (12/11 versus 10); the same ESLint command now passes with URL behavior retained by 60 route tests and 25 focused report tests. Final main integration and captures remain pending predecessor PR 54. Final integration of main e61aa3509 preserves canonical metadata, config values, device capture selection and SSR workloads. Reports unit tests pass 672/672; focused root tests pass 149/149, including unchanged readable contracts, ownership, route, shared impact and regression metadata guards. The standard navbar matrix exposed a stale seventh-link focus assertion after adding Styles. Coverage now checks every destination focus ring and inactive underline, plus Styles and retained Helpers navigation at all three widths; all 18 shell checks pass. Earlier fad165855 captures retain their original tree; fresh final-tree capture is required. Final workload review extends the Styles page benchmark to all nine directly changed product units, with explicit whole-page/shared-code attribution and per-viewport assertions. Earlier capture checkpoints stay bound to their source trees; the final expanded observation run follows this metadata commit. Git-only readback diagnosed a missing ownership assertion: generic screens slots retained bytes but did not match Styles scenario slots, so unit previews were empty. The existing evidence test now asserts the declared per-state slot before the producer repair; a matched red-green run will retain this guard unchanged. The first slot-red attempt was refused because the old API could not admit the new destination option; it is not defect proof. API-compatible red keeps legacy output and reaches the slot assertion. The producer fix changes a frozen test fixture, so strict paired green is inapplicable without weakening the guard; final same-command independent capture and Git unit readback remain required.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
steps.evidence: Root and Reports typechecks, root lint, both audits, registry/scenario checks and scoped formatting pass. Full CLI/native suites remain explicitly deferred; independent exact-tree capture follows the final committed tree.
